task.title: Configure incoming webhooks in Google Chat
task.shortdesc: In Google spaces, create a new webhook to connect with the Hybrid Cloud Console.

ul.li: You have a new or existing Google space in Google Chat.

step.cmd: In your Google space, click the arrow on the space name to open the dropdown menu:
Enter the following information in the Incoming webhooks dialog:

substep.cmd: Enter a name for the integration (for example, Engineering Google Chat).
Optional: To add an avatar for the notifications, enter a URL to an image.
Click Save to generate the webhook URL.
Copy the webhook URL to use for configuration in the Hybrid Cloud Console.

link.linktext: Send messages to Google Chat with incoming webhooks
